description: Show a star with an orbiting planet by combining the Star mobject with a Planet mobject, demonstrating the complete manim-astronomy solar system setup.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_Astronomy import Star, Planet

class StarWithPlanet(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        star = Star(
            radius=0.4,
            num_of_particles=400,
            size_of_particle=0.005,
            colors=[YELLOW],
        )
        planet = Planet(
            center=np.array([2.0, 0.0, 0.0]),
            radius=0.15,
        )
        self.add(star, planet)
        self.wait(0.5)
